Playable PvAI prototype · 16-card training decks · New leader effects and combat values are experimental.
THE COMMANDER’S FIELD GUIDE

Every card becomes an order.

  1. Tap the battlefield. Click or tap the West, Center, or East area of the 3D ground. The gold outline shows where your next card will deploy. Troops enter from your left Stronghold and advance automatically.
  2. Deploy your army. Select Infantry, Archers, or Guards. Both armies fight continuously; Command replenishes over time.
  3. Change the whole battle. Fire Arrows permanently upgrades all your archers, including future squads. One doctrine, every Front.
  4. Lead in your own way. Indigo protects, Lucy controls distance, Nezz pursues wounded enemies. Use your exclusive leader command.
  5. Make an Oath. Keep allies on a Front for 12 seconds. Fulfillment returns your bound Soul and rewards you. Losing every allied squad there turns that Soul into Debt.
  6. Break their Stronghold. Unopposed squads attack it. Reduce its Integrity to zero to win. Both falling in the same simulation step is a draw.

Each squad represents three soldiers. Its health controls visible casualties. Played cards are replaced from your deck; the discard reshuffles when the deck empties. Fire Arrows cannot stack. Cards 1–5 can also be played with your keyboard. Pausing is available in this single-player prototype.

This is a new real-time concept mode. It carries forward the three Fronts, leader identity, Command, Soul, and Oaths. Live resource regeneration, 16-card training decks, and new card values are prototype rules. Campaign progression, a full collection/deck builder, multiplayer, and final character animation are future work.
